sources.name: Malaysia KPDN PriceCatcher
sources.attribution: KPDN / data.gov.my, CC BY 4.0. Median across reporting premises; at least 10 premises per item. 39 daily-collected staples (chicken, eggs, fish and seafood, vegetables, onions, garlic, potatoes and limes) use the latest completed day on which every one reported, against exactly seven days earlier. 19 basket items (packaged rice, cooking oil, sugar, flour, coconut, meat and fruit) are only surveyed on irregular basket days, so each shows its own latest survey date against its most recent survey at least seven days earlier. Premises and sample composition may vary, including on public holidays. Units are per kg unless the row says otherwise.
